narrative:
Operating costs are about GBP 214M in the Q3 forecast (32% of revenue), planned by cost center and legal entity:

• Partner channel & commissions — commissions, volume rebates and MDF for about 150 partners
• Direct sales & marketing for enterprise and public sector
• Network, IT & product — including the SQL Server and MySQL to Snowflake migration
• Customer operations & billing
• G&A, people & integration — Epiris transaction costs and Germany integration

Partner commissions and rebates are the largest controllable line and the main lever for migration mix.

signals.title: Recommended cash offer from Epiris (Bradbury Bidco)
signals.source: Gamma Communications plc — Rule 2.7 announcement, 1 September 2026
signals.excerpt: 1,120 pence per share; equity value about £1.015bn and enterprise value about £1.079bn. Completion expected in H1 2027, subject to approvals.

signals.title: Germany synergy tracker — cost synergies behind plan
signals.excerpt: £2.4M of cost synergies delivered YTD against £4.5M phased; two of five platform migrations slipped to Q1 2027; revenue synergies ahead (£1.8M vs £1.5M).
